description: Configurable performance baselines. A baseline is a recorded p95 for one platform, not a claim that platforms have equal timings. The default tolerance is 0.25, so a 1.5x regression fails. A required metric with no measurement, too few runs, a unit mismatch, a non-finite value, or no platform baseline also fails. Pass --enforce-budgets to make the status govern the process exit code.

stress.description: Separate cross-mode profiles. The Web Light Chromium source, Code, JSON and Split 1 MB cases carry reviewed local limits from a 20-run production build. Other modes, other browsers and all native profiles remain report-only. Report-only is not a strict pass. Existing platform metrics below do not change.

web-light-chromium-production.review: Calibrated on 2026-11-10 from a clean eda7dea production build, 20 runs each for source/markdown-1mb/lib-0, code/code-1mb/lib-0, json/json-1mb/lib-0 and split/markdown-1mb/lib-0. The highest observed p95 was 39.5 ms input-to-frame, 0.1 ms dispatch and 578.1 ms save including the 400 ms product delay. Limits keep about 50 percent headroom. Parent review is required before merge.

native-complete-linux-webkitgtk-debug.review: Recorded local Linux WebKitGTK debug baseline from the native mode matrix on 2026-11-10.
